text:
**STEP 1 - Scene:** This is a fresh fruit plate with strawberries, blueberries, raspberries, blackberries, cantaloupe and pineapple chunks.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** It is a large square white plate, about 26 cm across, roughly dinner-plate size. I used the circle-equivalent area: 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Strawberry halves (about 3)
- Blueberries (about 12)
- Raspberries (2–3)
- Blackberries (about 2)
- Cantaloupe chunks (about 9)
- Pineapple chunks (about 6)

There is no dressing or sauce.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Food covers about 35% of the plate.

| Item | Share of plate |
|---|---|
| Strawberries | 6% |
| Blueberries | 3% |
| Raspberries + blackberries | 4% |
| Cantaloupe | 12% |
| Pineapple | 10% |
| **Total** | **35%** |

**STEPS 5–7 - Volume, grams and energy:**

| Item | Area (cm²) | Height (cm) | Volume (ml) | Density | Grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Strawberries | 32 | 2 | 64 | 0.6 | 38 | 32 | 12 |
| Blueberries | 16 | 1.2 | 19 | 0.6 | 12 → 14* | 57 | 8 |
| Raspberries/blackberries | 21 | 2 | 42 | 0.6 | 25 | 48 | 12 |
| Cantaloupe | 64 | 2 | 127 | 0.6 | 76 | 34 | 26 |
| Pineapple | 53 | 2 | 106 | 0.6 | 64 | 50 | 32 |

*I rounded the blueberries up to 14 g to match a count of about 12 berries.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 217 g and about 90 kcal. That is a modest fruit plate covering about a third of a large plate, so the totals are plausible.
